name: Agent template from the Copilot plan
fits: A chat agent that works for a signed-in user, with that user's permissions, and asks before it does anything risky.

reusable.part: A hand-written LangGraph StateGraph: model and tools in a loop
reusable.gives: A loop you control and can test with a stub model
reusable.in_the_copilot: agent/copilot.py: remember, model, tools, confirm, save

reusable.part: A confirm node with interrupt(), resumed with Command(resume=...)
reusable.gives: A human approves before any risky action, and the graph resumes cleanly
reusable.in_the_copilot: confirm pauses before sign_off and checks in code that the handler may sign off

reusable.gives: A conversation survives restarts and new Runtime sessions
reusable.in_the_copilot: PostgresSaver on the shared pool, with prepared statements off

reusable.part: The user's sign-in in the graph's context (context_schema, read through ToolRuntime), never in the config
reusable.gives: Tokens are never saved in checkpoints
reusable.in_the_copilot: CopilotContext: the token, the handler, the conversation, the turn

reusable.part: The app owns the conversations, turns and steps tables
reusable.gives: The UI reads one trusted state, even after a reload
reusable.in_the_copilot: conversations, turns and copilot_steps in backend/store.py

reusable.part: The agent calls the app with the user's sign-in, never a service key
reusable.gives: The agent can never do more than the user can
reusable.in_the_copilot: agent/copilot_api.py; the app answers 401 to a request that carries the agent's key

reusable.gives: Long jobs cost no model calls
reusable.in_the_copilot: wait_for_run reads the run every 5 seconds, up to 15 minutes
check_success_criteria builds the three rows; the app fills the confirmation card from its records

reusable.part: An AgentCore app entrypoint, with each turn's work as an async task
reusable.gives: The same deploy route as the claim agent
The agent remembers each user across conversations
reusable.in_the_copilot: AgentCoreMemoryStore under ("handlers", handler_id), saving only the message and the answer

replace_each_time: The data the agent reads (for the Copilot: claims, customers, runs)
Who may approve what (for the Copilot: Marcus can't sign off over the approval limit)

fits_badly.why: The plan polls about once a second while a turn is working

fits_badly.case: No user in the loop, such as batch jobs
fits_badly.why: Use the claim agent's pattern for those

fits_badly.case: Several agents handing work to each other
fits_badly.why: This is one agent with one graph
